CustomField.formula: IF(AND( OR(TEXT(SBQQ__Product__r.Family) = 'Subs - Law.com', TEXT(SBQQ__Product__r.Family) = 'Subs - Law Journal Press', TEXT(SBQQ__Product__r.Family) = 'Subs - Regional'), OR(AND(UPPER(TRIM(Promo_Code__c)) = 'OE', ISBLANK(TEXT(License_Model_Override__c))), TEXT(License_Model__c) = 'Firmwide License') ), 'Firmwide License means access for all Authorised Users within the Customer organisation.' & IF(Warranted_Headcount__c > 0, ' The Customer represents that, as of the Effective Date, it has approximately ' & TEXT(Warranted_Headcount__c) & ' Authorised Users. The Customer shall promptly notify the Company if the number of Authorised Users increases by more than ' & IF(Headcount_Notify_Override__c > 0, TEXT(Headcount_Notify_Override__c), IF(Warranted_Headcount__c <= 30, '5', IF(Warranted_Headcount__c <= 100, '10', IF(Warranted_Headcount__c <= 150, '20', '5%')))) & ', and the Company reserves the right to adjust the applicable Fees to reflect such increase.', ''), '')
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Prints in the Licence Model column when a Law.com-family line is a Firmwide License: Shinae's approved wording (9 Sep 2026) with the notify-increase figure from Richard's bands (5 / 10 / 20; 5% above 150 attorneys) or the legal-approved override.
CustomField.label: Law.com Firmwide Sentence
